study: Rich & Gureckis (2018) The limits of learning: Exploration, generalization, and the development of learning traps, JEP:General, DOI 10.1037/xge0000466
key_findings: Resolved OSF: author data at 5d6sv (data/data_exp1.csv, data_exp2.csv); FLoRA/SCORE reproduction at u8zk5 with Analysis code and human Audit record 21mg2.

Independently recomputed all headline rule-consistency scores at test from raw CSVs (Python reimplementation of provided R scoring): Exp1 contingent 1D .834/full 1D .748, 2D .716/.816; Exp2 contingent 1D .857/full .750, 2D .788/.873.
All 8 headline means match the paper's stated values (.83/.75/.72/.82 and .86/.75/.78/.87) to 2-decimal precision; directions of all comparisons correct.
Human audit record (21mg2_audit1.csv) shows repro_possible=Yes, values_match=Yes, and a posterior CI (|-.146,-.025| reversed => [.025,.146]) confirming the paper's Exp1 1D CI [.03,.14].

OSF API was in maintenance during part of the audit, preventing independent re-derivation of secondary questiondata claims (danger-percent, dimension identification); those are supported by the human reproduction but not re-run here.
Bayesian 95% posterior CIs rely on the provided Stan model; confirmed indirectly via the human audit rather than a fresh independent Stan fit.
notes: Full numerical reproduction achieved for the primary headline claims. Original paywalled PDF was downloaded to a temp area for inspection and deleted before finishing, per copyright constraints. No git commands were run.
